scope: matched native VT Unicode throughput; excludes rendering and physical input latency
method: Each sample compares active/history text, widths, styles, wrapping and cursor metadata after feeding and after narrow/restore resize. Engine order is randomized per sample.

actual_pty.note: AkiTTY native worker/model only; grapheme defaults and fixtures differ from the matched engine probe.

qualification: Before and after drivers were measured sequentially; ordinary desktop activity was present.
Ghostty is the official pinned benchmark library, not the full Ghostty application.
No renderer, full-app responsiveness, energy, or physical key-to-photon comparison is made.
Small differences between neighboring runs are not assigned causal meaning.
